description: Prefix acceptance is performed during construction but not replayed during activation or triggered reset.
trigger: Construct FormatronFilter with read_prompt enabled and a nonempty prefix_str, then start its Job.
expected_behavior: The prefix should remain accepted before generation, as the Filter parameter contract describes.
actual_behavior: The constructor calls accept_bytes, but Job.activate immediately calls reset. FormatronFilter.reset only delegates to the formatter and does not reaccept prefix_str. If formatter reset clears accepted input, the initial prefix is lost. With prefix_str=None, the enabled constructor branch instead attempts None.encode.

verification.description: Compared constructor acceptance with both new reset callers: job activation and trigger activation. No parent Formatron callers existed in the literal search.
verification.limits: Actual formatter reset semantics and EngineGenerationConfig defaults were not inspected; prefix-loss conclusion is conditional on reset clearing accepted input.
